method: Same model drafts and grounding decisions, actual before/after VoiceDirector on device. Post-consumption deletion-only economy step, no new prompts/weights/samplers/generation. GPT direct scores only after actual replay; unchanged texts reuse labels.
rules: Exact adjacent repeated units/blocks and long acknowledgement filler runs; narrow generic closing removal only with meaningful prefix or concise request. Preserve requested repetition, quoted/code/URL text, needed/vague clarification, requested interviews/questions and sentence floors. No semantic paraphrase or fabricated answers.
rubric: Same content/register/honesty/identity-role/memory/instruction criteria as baseline. Known development questions, same author knows conditions; not blind/independent/human.
scope_limit: Literal/lexical only; no guarantee that all repeated meanings or irrelevant topic questions are detected. Consumer effect is not improved model knowledge.
development_note: Initial 54-response replay exposed a short named-answer tail; added named-answer coverage plus missing-information and requested-question guards, then reran all 54. Development comparison, not preregistered holdout.
